findings.summary: Runtime crash: imports removed singleton 'tokenTracker' -- 'trackUsage' called on undefined
findings.failure_scenario: Agent calls dedupQueries() at agent.ts:447 or :481. dedup.ts:3 imports { tokenTracker } from token-tracker.ts but that named export was deleted. At line 122, tokenTracker.trackUsage('dedup', tokens) throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined, crashing the entire getResponse() workflow. All API requests fail with error events through the SSE endpoint.

findings.summary: Runtime crash: imports removed singleton 'tokenTracker' -- 'trackUsage' called on undefined
findings.failure_scenario: Agent calls analyzeSteps() at agent.ts:409. error-analyzer.ts:3 imports { tokenTracker } but the export was removed. At line 128, tokenTracker.trackUsage('error-analyzer', tokens) throws TypeError. All API request error-analysis paths crash.

findings.summary: SSE progress events never sent: ActionTracker listener registered after all events already emitted
findings.failure_scenario: server.ts line 83 awaits getResponse() which completes fully, emitting all 'action' events during its execution. Line 85 then registers context.actionTracker.on('action', emitProgress) -- but EventEmitter does not replay past events, and no more trackAction() calls will ever fire for this context. SSE clients on /api/v1/stream/:requestId receive only the final { type: 'answer' } event; all intermediate progress updates are silently dropped.

findings.summary: rewriteQuery called without token tracker -- token usage silently discarded from budget tracking
findings.failure_scenario: Agent loop at line 476: rewriteQuery(thisStep) is called without passing context.tokenTracker. The fallback (tracker || new TokenTracker()) in query-rewriter.ts:118 creates a throwaway tracker whose data is never added to the budget. Each query-rewrite call's Gemini API token usage is invisible to the budget check at line 271, so the agent may exceed tokenBudget without detection.

findings.summary: CLI main() prints zero-token summary: creates fresh empty TokenTracker instead of using context's
findings.failure_scenario: main() at line 659 correctly destructures getResponse() into { result, context } but then ignores context. Line 661 creates new TokenTracker() with zero usage entries and calls printSummary(). CLI output always shows { total: 0, breakdown: {} } regardless of actual tokens consumed.
